newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union shareholders approve floatation.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union shareholders approve floatation.

text.p: Members of the Norwich Union, Britain's third-largest life insurer, voted overwhelmingly Friday in favour of listing the company on the London Stock Exchange.
Results of a mail-in vote showed a 98.9 percent in favour of the scheme. The company needed the backing of three quarters of those who voted.
The official result will be announced next Tuesday, after the votes cast at an extraordinary general meeting, which about 200 members attended, are included.
The flotation, the first by a mutually-owned British insurer, will value it at around 5 billion pounds ($8.2 billion) and rank Norwich among Britain's 50 largest companies.
Some 1,850,673 mail votes were in favour, with 21,145 against, Norwich said.
